name: Nimble
description: Nimble is a relationship-focused CRM for contacts, companies, activities, deals, pipelines, messages, enrichment, and workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Nimble API key, then let agents list only bounded projected contact-field metadata under approval. Relay excludes private presentation and validation logic, choices, actions, CRM/message data, writes, administration, exports, bulk operations, and raw API access.

credentialRequirements.name: NIMBLE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Nimble API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated least-privilege API key and store it only through Relay's encrypted flow.

capabilities.label: List contact-field metadata
capabilities.description: List at most 100 tab/group/field names, contact types, field IDs, modifiers, cardinality, read-only state, and field kinds without private schema logic or CRM records.

approvalRequired.label: List contact-field metadata
approvalRequired.description: List bounded projected contact-field metadata from Nimble.

blocked.label: Access CRM or message data
blocked.description: Contacts, companies, tags, notes, activities, deals, pipelines, messages, drafts, and relationship data are blocked.

blocked.label: Access private schema logic
blocked.description: Presentation settings, validation rules, choices, possible actions, logos, IDs for layout containers, and full metadata are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or administer Nimble
blocked.description: Creates, updates, deletes, imports, exports, enrichment, email drafts, fields, groups, tabs, choices, pipelines, and settings changes are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk API access
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, searches, raw responses, bulk access, pagination, redirects, and retries are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded field-metadata read requires approval; CRM/message data, private schema logic, writes, administration, bulk, and raw APIs remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded metadata read runs without Relay per-action approval; fixed origin/path binding, projection, caps, audits, and no-write behavior remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway binds a customer-owned API key to Nimble's fixed API origin and a projected contact-field metadata wrapper.
Railway binds a customer-owned API key to Nimble's fixed API origin and a projected contact-field metadata wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: An authorized Nimble administrator must enable API access, provision a dedicated least-privilege API key, and store it through Relay. No account, OAuth app, key, credential capture, consent, live request, or provider acceptance is available in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized administrator provisions the least-privilege key, stores it through Relay, then verifies health, one approved metadata list, throttling, key rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Nimble documents Bearer authentication and GET /api/v1/contacts/fields returning tab, group, and field metadata including IDs, names, contact types, cardinality, read-only state, field types, validation, presentation, choices, and actions. Relay projects only the narrow identity/type subset.
Nimble documents API access with an Authorization Bearer API key and metadata API support. Relay encrypts the key, makes one fixed read, and blocks record and mutation surfaces.
